evidence.summary: Tinder documents similar-photo recommendation cues and July 2024 Photo Selector. Those announcements do not authenticate the reel code, replicate its synthetic-image tests or convert scores to measured matches. Only the identified source scope was checked; other historical claims remain outside this review.
evidence.limits: The vendor documents support the announced features, not authentication of the reel’s extracted code or deployment. No experiments were independently replicated, no company response was obtained and present-day app access was not tested. This is not a full fact-check.

corrections.note: Reframed the body as consumer-consequences analysis using the existing reel record and dated Tinder documents. Added shared research/ownership disclosure and distinct questions about photos, permissions and purchases. No new field reporting, independent replication or company response was obtained.
